scope: Q01 accuracy metrics and Q02 base/small performance metrics

corpus.selectionRule: For browser download-name collisions, select the last saved candidate by LastWriteTime; retain every original file.

conclusion.note: The frozen plan defines required measurements but no pass threshold. This evidence proves execution and records quality; it does not claim accuracy target approval.

privacy: No audio, reference text, recognized text, credentials, private paths, or model weights are included.

diagnostics.interpretation: speaker-c is about 3.45 dB quieter than speaker-a and has a higher near-silence rate; these measurements may explain part, but not all, of its higher CER.
